messages:
jamal: Heads up — new canary deploy (deploy-2026-03-15-enc-config) is CrashLoopBackOffing in us-west-2. Init sidecar failing on config parse.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-6543 created and assigned to @sophia (primary-oncall). Paging now.

sophia: on it. jamal share the deploy id/logs and whether this is a configmap-only roll.

jamal: deploy id: deploy-2026-03-15-enc-config. It's a configmap shape change + image bump. No manual SA changes in pipeline, but seeing token errors on a subset of pods.

kevin: quick logs from one canary pod: 
```
ERROR: failed to parse config schema: expected object at path 'models[0].params', got string
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/encoder/init.py", line 42, in <module>
    cfg = load_schema('/etc/enc/config.yml')
  File "/app/encoder/config.py", line 88, in load_schema
    raise SchemaError('expected object')
SchemaError: expected object at models[0].params
```

ira: also seeing node kubelet warnings and projected SA token mount errors on 2/3 failing pods: 
```
W 12:34:56 token projected volume missing
E 12:34:57 failed to open token file: permission denied
client: failed to read credentials
```

natalia: odd — last night infra rotated a subset of projected tokens on a couple nodes as part of a security roll. Could be coincident but might amplify boot failures.

deploy-bot: rollout deploy-2026-03-15-enc-config -> canary subset created, configmap updated to enc-config-v2. No SA rotation step recorded in pipeline.

sophia: OK two likely contributors: (1) configmap schema incompatible with v1 parser -> immediate crashes, (2) node-level token churn causing mount errors on some nodes. Priority: stop canary traffic, trigger rollback to enc-config-v1 and previous image. Jamal, toggle the feature flag kill-switch and we'll roll back.

jamal: toggled feature flag `enc-config-v2.enabled` -> false :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: feature flag off observed, initiating canary abort hook. Rolling back canary to image `encoder:v12` + configmap `enc-config-v1`.

kevin: kubectl snapshot: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=encoder,canary -o wide` shows old pods terminating, new old-version pods creating.

ira: note: HPA for canary had minReplicas: 0 in the canary template which allowed autoscaler to scale to 0 during node churn window — bumped minReplicas to 2 for canary-template to avoid total visibility loss.

sophia: update for stakeholders: customer impact limited. Routing weight to canary was 0.8% in us-west-2, about ~0.7% of global inference traffic. Observed 502/503 spike only for that small subset. Status page and support notified.

pagerduty-bot: @sophia acknowledged incident and is incident lead.

natalia: after rollback logs look clean: 
```
INFO encoder v12 startup complete
INFO loaded config schema v1
```

deploy-bot: rollback completed in 47s, canary pods replaced with previous revision.

sophia: pods healthy, latency and error rate back to baseline. Incident mitigated. Next actions: add configmap schema validation to CI (block merges that change schema shape), add deploy guard to prevent SA token rotation during in-progress deploys, and ensure canary HPA minReplicas > 0. Jamal please open the postmortem ticket and assign.

jamal: opened postmortem INC-2026-6543-postmortem -> https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-6543 :link: (assigned to jamal + kevin + natalia)

kevin: additional recommendations: limit canary routing weight to 1% max, alert when CrashLoopBackOff > 3 restarts in 5m for any canary, and add CI/contract test for configmap schema compatibility.

sophia: agree. I'm updating the runbook now, will include explicit rollback & kill-switch steps and a checklist for infra token rotations. Handing off oncall to kevin in 10m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

jamal: leaving a short note in #status: "INC-2026-6543 mitigated — canary config rollback; limited impact to small % of us-west traffic; postmortem filed."

kevin: will monitor for 30m and then mark resolved if stable.

sophia: resolved->monitoring. Postmortem owners to sync tomorrow.
